name: Create Async Scraping Job with Scrape.do
description: Create an asynchronous web scraping job with Scrape.do. Supports multiple target URLs, geo-targeting, device emulation, rendering, proxy options, and markdown output for LLM workflows.

geoCode.description: Country code for geo-targeting (e.g., US, GB, DE)

device.description: Device to emulate: desktop, mobile, tablet

output.description: Output format: raw or markdown (markdown is ideal for LLM workflows)

super.description: Use residential proxies for harder-to-scrape sites
